title: Encrypted EBS Volume
scenario: Create a small encrypted EBS volume for a single instance, keeping size within the free tier.

focus.title: Complete the aws_ebs_volume resource
focus.todo: Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_ebs_volume.

hints.why: EC2 teaches the core lifecycle of compute: image, instance type, networking, storage and safe replacement.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `resource "aws_ebs_volume" "this"`. Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_ebs_volume. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Use EC2 when you need a virtual machine you control directly, or as a building block inside an autoscaling or container platform.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `resource "aws_ebs_volume" "this"`. Use this code shape: availability_zone; size; encrypted. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `var.availability_zone`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
